confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Edinburgh price levels; no live listings or menus were checked. Beer assumes a pint. Food, beer and coffee are moderately reliable; cocktail and wine are less certain; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because July demand is seasonal. USD values assume an approximate working GBP-USD rate, not a looked-up one. The FX figure was read from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange rates overview page; the page itself was not opened directly, and no 14 October RBA figure was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general UK city-centre price levels for historic tourism cities with similar restaurant and hotel pricing, such as York and Bath, with Glasgow as a lower-cost Scottish reference point.
